run_autograd_tests: run the GTN autograd unit tests to verify gradient computation for graph operations
test_numerical_grad_check: test numerical gradient checking by perturbing arc weights and comparing against computed gradients
test_forward_score_grad: test gradient computation for forward_score on graphs with multiple start and accept nodes
test_viterbi_score_grad: test gradient computation for viterbi_score on graphs with multiple paths and accept nodes
test_scalar_ops_grad: test gradient computation for scalar graph operations including add, subtract, and negate
